skills.name: Flagellate
skills.text: Scourge yourself, spending {life} Life, to deal {dmgPct}% more damage for {turns} turns. Takes no time.

variants.name: Scarred Resolve
variants.text: You also gain {armourPct}% armour while it lasts.

variants.name: Shared Suffering
variants.text: Every adjacent foe takes damage equal to the Life you spent.

variants.name: Ecstasy
variants.text: The pain restores {manaPct}% of your max Mana.

skills.name: Iron Penance
skills.text: Your armour rises by {armourPct}% and your max Life by {lifePct}%.

skills.name: Bear the Sin
skills.text: Call every foe you can see within {radius} tiles to strike at you: they are Taunted for {turns} turns, and you take {takenCut}% less damage meanwhile.

variants.name: Martyr's Draw
variants.text: Taunted foes are pulled {pull} tiles toward you.

variants.name: Reflective
variants.text: While it lasts, melee attackers take {reflectPct}% of their damage back.

variants.name: Unyielding
variants.text: While it lasts, you cannot be Stunned.

skills.name: Blood Price
skills.text: {manaPct}% of the damage you take returns to you as Mana.

skills.name: Hair Shirt
skills.text: Put on the hair shirt: while you wear it you lose {upkeep} Life each turn, and every foe that strikes you takes {thorns} Physical damage in return.

variants.name: Cilice of Flame
variants.text: The thorns deal Fire damage and set attackers Burning.

skills.name: Stigmata
skills.text: Open your wounds, spending {life} Life: your next {attacks} attacks deal {dmgPct}% more damage and heal you for {healPct}% of the damage they deal.

variants.name: Crown of Thorns
variants.text: Opening the wounds also deals {burst} Physical damage to every foe within {burstRadius} tile.

variants.name: Blessed Blood
variants.text: The healing also mends your companion, once one walks with you.

variants.name: Overflow
variants.text: Healing beyond your max Life becomes a barrier that lasts {turns} turns.

skills.name: Last Rites
skills.text: Once every {interval} turns, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 Life instead, and you cannot be harmed for {invulnTurns} turns.

skills.name: Martyr's Vigil
skills.text: Keep a vigil for up to {turns} turns: you cannot move and take {takenCut}% less damage. When it ends, {pct}% of the damage you absorbed is released as Physical damage to every foe within {radius} tiles. A ring shows its reach and the damage stored.

variants.name: Bulwark
variants.text: You take {takenCut}% less damage, but nothing is released.

variants.name: Martyr's Flame
variants.text: The release is Fire damage and sets foes Burning.

strings.tree.desc: Suffer for your faith: pay in Life, draw your foes' blows and turn your wounds into weapons.
strings.buff.flagellation.name: Flagellation
strings.buff.flagellation.desc: Self-inflicted pain lends your strikes fury: you deal {pct}% more damage for {turns} more turns.
strings.buff.bear_the_sin.name: Bearing the Sin
strings.buff.bear_the_sin.desc: You call your foes' wrath onto yourself and endure it: you take {pct}% less damage for {turns} more turns.
strings.buff.bear_the_sin.reflect: Foes that strike you up close take {pct}% of their blow back.
strings.buff.hair_shirt.name: Hair Shirt
strings.buff.hair_shirt.desc: A garment of penance. It chafes {upkeep} Life away each turn and returns {thorns} damage to every foe that strikes you.
strings.buff.stigmata.name: Stigmata
strings.buff.stigmata.desc: Your wounds are open. Your next attacks deal {pct}% more damage and heal you for {heal}% of it. Attacks left: {count}.
strings.buff.overflow.name: Overflowing Blood
strings.buff.overflow.desc: Blood your body could not hold now shields you: {barrier} damage, for {turns} more turns.
strings.buff.last_rites_spent.name: Rites Spent
strings.buff.last_rites_spent.desc: Last Rites will not answer again for {turns} turns.
strings.buff.vigil.name: Martyr's Vigil
strings.buff.vigil.desc: You stand fast and gather the blows you endure: {pct}% of every hit is held back. When the vigil ends, {dmg} damage returns to your foes. Turns left: {turns}.
strings.log.hair_shirt_off: You have no Life left to give: the hair shirt falls away.
strings.refuse.vigil: You break your vigil and hold your ground.
